definitions: The logical error of concentrating on the people or things that made it past some selection process and overlooking those that did not, typically because of their lack of visibility.
A cognitive bias that occurs when one focuses only on successful outcomes and ignores failures, leading to an inaccurate perception of reality.
examples: The study was criticized for survivorship bias.
Understanding survivorship bias is crucial in data analysis.
Many business success stories are affected by survivorship bias.
